WalletProfile.title: WalletProfile
WalletProfile.description: Real-time MFS wallet account profile storing balance, savings summary, reward points, KYC tier, and biometric preference.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID owning this wallet.

pinHash.description: Hashed MFS PIN for transaction authorization.

biometricEnabled.description: Whether biometric touch/face authentication is enabled for MFS transactions.

balanceBdt.description: Available liquid MFS balance in BDT.

totalSavingsBdt.description: Total accumulated savings across all active DPS and savings vaults in BDT.

rewardPoints.description: TakaPay reward points earned from transactions.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when wallet was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when wallet was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

MfsTransaction.title: MfsTransaction
MfsTransaction.description: Financial transaction record for Send Money, Add Money, Cash Out, Mobile Recharge, Utility Bill, Merchant QR Payment, or Savings transfer.

userId.description: Authenticated user UID owning this ledger entry.

recipientNumber.description: Target mobile number, meter number, biller ID, or merchant code.

recipientName.description: Recipient, merchant, or biller display name.

operatorOrProvider.description: Telco operator, utility provider, bank, or merchant category.

feeBdt.description: Service fee or cash-out charge in BDT.

balanceAfterBdt.description: Wallet balance immediately following the transaction in BDT.

referenceNote.description: Optional user reference or invoice note.

authMethod.description: Security authentication method used to authorize the transaction.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last update (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

SavingsGoal.title: SavingsGoal
SavingsGoal.description: Real-time savings vault or DPS goal linked to the user's MFS wallet.

title.description: Name of the savings vault or DPS goal.

targetAmountBdt.description: Target maturity or savings goal amount in BDT.

savedAmountBdt.description: Current accumulated balance in this savings goal in BDT.

monthlyDepositBdt.description: Planned monthly installment amount in BDT.

institutionName.description: Partner bank or financial institution hosting the DPS/Vault.

autoSaveRoundUp.description: Whether spare change round-up is enabled for this goal.

status.description: Current status of the savings vault.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when goal was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when goal was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

SavedBiller.title: SavedBiller
SavedBiller.description: Saved utility biller, favorite P2P contact, merchant QR, or cash-out agent for quick repeat transactions.

name.description: Display label for the saved biller or contact.

accountOrMeterNo.description: Phone number, meter number, customer ID, or merchant code.

providerCategory.description: Utility category or operator name (e.g., Electricity, Gas, Water, Internet, Personal).

/wallets/{userId}.description: Stores each user's real-time MFS wallet balance, savings total, and security preferences.

/users/{userId}/transactions/{transactio.description: Stores real-time MFS transaction history per user.

/users/{userId}/savings_goals/{goalId}.description: Stores real-time DPS and savings vaults per user.

/users/{userId}/saved_billers/{billerId}.description: Stores saved utility billers, favorite contacts, and merchants per user.
